sentences.en: You will be delayed for only thirty minutes at worst.
sentences.zh: 最坏的情况下你只会耽搁三十分钟。

sentences.en: We should take into account that the train was delayed.
sentences.zh: 我们得考虑到火车已经延迟了。

sentences.en: A rush-hour traffic jam delayed my arrival by two hours.
sentences.zh: 高峰时段的交通堵塞使我迟到了两小时。

senses.zh: 延迟的时间；延期；延时；延迟器
